en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on martial arts
What a documentary on pop stars

There it is! Degenerate males' favorite move!
Males' "bond" of true friendship!
I have no interest in you or Gonta!

If you wanna show off true friendship, learn
from girls! Like going to the bathroom together!

How can degenerate males say they're true
friends if they can't even pee together!

Mmhm, I see... Grab the opponent's head
and then knee their forehead...

I will consult Master to see if we can
assimilate that into Neo-Aikido!

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like I showed her something
I shouldn't have...

Pop stars are great! They're such cute flowers
with joyful personalities!
Just looking at them brightens up my day!
But...

Male pop stars!
I can't stand them!

What's so fun about watching sweaty
degenerates dance around in weird clothes?

I'll never understand that!
Pop stars should only be girls!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tenko's inner thoughts...?
